result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but the active 'Pizza' category filter does not appear to affect the listings, and the favorite (heart) button on the second popular card uses an inconsistent dark treatment with poor icon contrast.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected (dark/active), yet the listings below include poké, burgers, ramen and other non-pizza restaurants — the filter appears to have no effect on the displayed results.
issues.suggestion: Apply the selected category filter to the result lists, or reset the chip to 'All' when no filtering is applied.

issues.description: The favorite heart button on the second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is rendered as a dark circle with a dark outlined heart, unlike the white circular button on the ramen card above it. The icon nearly disappears against its own background.
issues.suggestion: Use the same white/translucent circular button and dark heart icon for all favorite toggles, ensuring sufficient icon-to-background contrast.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, favorite hearts, search icon) have no visible text labels, which may leave them unlabeled for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites') to all icon-only buttons.
